hypothesis_text: Increasing sampling temperature from 0.0 to 0.7 increases the variance of LLM defection decisions in repeated PD but does not change the mean cooperation rate.
prior_art_summary: Prior LLM-in-PD work (e.g., Horton 2023 territory; Aher et al. 2023 on LLM simulations) reports temperature sweeps; a variance-up-mean-stable result is a modest extension within that line.
rationale: Extends a known line with a quantifiable finding; valuable but not surprising. Mid-low novelty.
